newsitem.title: USA: DeepTech says chairman exercises warrants.
newsitem.headline: DeepTech says chairman exercises warrants.

text.p: DeepTech International Inc said Friday said chairman and chief executive Thomas Tatham exercised 722,917 warrants to purchase an equivalent amount of the company's common shares.
A total of 447,917 warrants were exercised for $4.50 per share and 275,000 warrants were exercised for $10.00 per share, the company said.
The company said the warrant exercise was made pursuant to existing warrant agreements held by Tatham.

As a result of the exercise, the expiration date on 2.2 million other warrants held by Tatham were extended by one year, about 1.3 million of which expire July 15, 1998 and 825,000 of which expire on November 7, 1998.
Tatham currently holds about 38 percent of DeepTech's outstanding common stock.
